protos.creator: Presto
protos.name: Ero the Proto 2.0
protos.description: He is a freelance Aerocat design supporter and designer. His main work involves subcontracting for other designers or performing freelance tasks that include identifying structural flaws and redesigning accordingly. He has a fresh and slightly eccentric way of thinking, and it is known that his hobby is drawing peculiar CATS-themed comics or doujinshi.

equipment.name: Claw pen 2.0
equipment.description: This is a claw-shaped pen compatible with the painting tool Proto Paint Studio 4.0, and while in use its tip flashes in the exact color you’ve selected.

protos.creator: Robert
protos.name: Buster the Proto P
protos.description: Personality: Somewhat Nice but mostly...somewhat loose

protos.creator: Const
protos.name: Const the Proto 2.0
protos.description:
Const is a V2 PROTO originally engineered for the high-performance CATS unit x#7!qL9z@. Following the unit’s decommissioning due to cause string x@3F!92_∆5, Const remained unassigned for an extended period. During this time, he developed traits atypical of standard PROTOs, including an aversion to menial tasks and a preference for research and technical work—behaviors more closely aligned with CATS units.

He was later reassigned to operate with Radian, the F-22. While they are seldom observed together in operations, they are regarded as maintaining a strong private rapport.

protos.creator: Kasichi
protos.name: Kasichi the Proto 2.0
protos.description: KsC, or Kasichi, is the latest PROTO unit, version 2.0. Known for his quiet nature when he focuses intently on his own tasks. Yet when approached in conversation, he is cheerful and friendly. As an independent operating PROTO, KsC works under contract for different factions and facilities to earn money and resources. Still, he makes time to rest, study, and even learn how to express emotions.

protos.creator: Merlin
protos.name: Itero the Proto P
protos.description: Itero is a very old proto in a relatively new body. Publicly the proto researches expanded functionality of padding goo, but they are wanted for questioning related to a number of less than ethically sound research projects and the potential violation of artificial entity rights. Secretly Itero seeks to find a means to personally become, functionally, immortal. One too many near death incidents has left him obsessed with avoiding permanent decommissioning.

protos.creator: NightRye_
protos.name: Pehr the Proto I
protos.description: Before Pehr was an Aerocat, he was a conscript for the army, serving as a crew chief/ramp agent for other Aerocats, often helping with rearming and refueling while engaging in a lot of conversations with other Aerocats to try and study about the mechanics of flying. He was selected as a prime candidate for the JAS-39E/F Proto Evolution Program and rebuilt for this reason as his superiors saw his potential as an aviator.

protos.creator: Kiote
protos.name: Shiela the Proto 2.0
protos.description: she often wonders around the bases hanging out with the train landcats and bigger aerocats while also managing the ground traffic and air traffic

protos.creator: Lossi
protos.name: Eva the Proto 2.0
protos.description:
He is a proto who does painting work.

He mainly does detailed work and has made a name for himself as a great tattooist for cats.

Although he uses old-fashioned methods, he is very skilled and is welcomed in many places. His hobby is graffiti.

protos.creator: gearwurk
protos.name: Repair the Proto P
protos.description: Repair is a repair unit, known to be able to fix and mend any type of CATs unit(s), he is able to tap into memories and data bases of other units to help him know the original blueprints and inside systems work and operate via touch. When there is no work for him, he tends to tinker and build other devices with spare parts he's collected.

protos.creator: Green PC
protos.name: Stanisław the Proto P
protos.description: Proto form of St. Ogn. Stanisław. This form is often used during formal events where proper attire is required, which Stanisław is too big for in his regular LANDCAT body. Additionally used for maintenance on his main LANDCAT body and in case of the body's destruction.

protos.creator: Mr.orlando
protos.name: Rookie the Proto P
protos.description:
This is, yep, Rookie
He (when originally nameless) is here for any CATS work, and meanwhile also aspiring for becoming (specifically) an AEROCATS someday… (it’s most unlikely)

protos.creator: Umbra
protos.name: Sol the Proto 2.0
protos.description: He bakes energy bars for CATS, and is the creator of the Spark energy bar brand.

protos.creator: Félix Auréle
protos.name: Mikhail the Proto 2.0
protos.description:
Usually in use when Mikhail's body is destroyed, or when he needs special training.
Carries around an AK with a drum magazine for self protection.
He is sometimes used when Mikhail needs maintenance in his more sensitive and important parts

protos.creator: Hikori
protos.name: Hikori the Proto 2.0
protos.description:
Usually found cleaning around a cargo ship, (actual) ship carrier, or whatever CATS base he's stationed at.

Has dreams of bring promoted into an actual CAT unit instead of just being a proto or backup body
The antenna on his head is used for taking in radio and information, including if any CATS data needs to be transferred to him incase an immediate Proto body isn't available. Though he is not exactly meant to be a permant replacement for decommissioned CATS. He also has a CD slot around his neck, being able to be used like a desktop if needed, all of the hardware for the computer part is stored in the, whatever you'd call the thing around his neck
Really talkative, but also has issues with freezing up or adding unnecessary pauses when talking, and sometimes has longer breaks between words than normal, typically only for one or two words.
His face isnt dynamic, having 10 eye images and 10 mouth images, allowing for only 100 facial expressions. He can display any images on his storage, though its hard to change back to his actual face, or change the image shown, taking a second or three to switch between them.

protos.creator: Zephyr
protos.name: Byte the Proto 2.0
protos.description: Byte is a proto specialized in programming. He knows a lot of programming languages and can learn any new language he needs at a moments notice. As he has been programming throughout the years he has developed different personalities that he likes to portray when he programs in a certain language. You can tell which module he is in based on the screen on his arm and his face. His name tag functions as a normal name tag as well as a projector for a mini debugger he likes to use when he encounters issues and needs to look at stuff closely. His paw pads help function as grip for typing as well as functioning as a 'fingerprint' biometric bypass. He only uses this when he has consent and the approval to do so in order to do what he needs to do.

protos.creator: ScarTheWerewolf
protos.name: Yumi the Proto 2.0
protos.description: A cheerful and tomboy proto that specialized in programming, payload and engineering. She's enjoying her work until she met Scar when she's wandering alone after her factory where once she work for destroyed into ruins. Ever since that, she always stay with her rescuer and do whatever she takes to ensure his safety.

protos.creator: Sandomite
protos.name: Eddie the Proto P
protos.description: Eddie's proto form. Originally a service proto [E-20] on a carrier, he was chosen out of many to be modified with external radar sensors replacing his normal ears to accustomize him to how his aerocat body will be operating with a 24/7 active radar. He was also kept in more personal areas of the carrier and forced to participate in classes and logic puzzles a plenty

protos.creator: Nicky Ferrius
protos.name: NF-05AX the Proto P
protos.description: Service prototype for the maintenance of machines and C.A.T.S units, used by the company AXE-CORP.

equipment.name: CATS manual
equipment.description: easter egg about me during my military service

protos.creator: TibbsThePooltoyOtter
protos.name: Cobalt the Proto 2.0
protos.description: Aquatic maintenance and survey prototype for machines or C.A.T.S units. When a pipe bursts, or a C.A.T.S unit makes an emergency aquatic landing, this unit is up to the task of locating and repairing anything out in the depths of the sea.

protos.creator: Copycat
protos.name: Shnur the Proto 2.0
protos.description:
A spare body with was generally provided for use in times of heavy maintenance of main CATS body or base spare personal requirements.

Recently has been assigned to use his Proto body more by his commanding officer in use for civilian work despite his military origin, his multiple requests to return him back to military purposes was denied.

Currently has been reported to work as a bartender, a spare base maintenance personal and several other unspecified jobs, possible misinformation from his commanding officer suspected.

protos.creator: Flare
protos.name: MP 4.2 the Proto 2.0
protos.description: Made to act as the dj on large music stages and able to be used has impromptu sound system for when a mobile sound system is required

protos.creator: Fwop
protos.name: Fwop the Proto 2.0
protos.description: Maintenence and handyman Proto for Shnur the Frogfoot, yells at him all the time to make sure he's okay

protos.creator: Sanya
protos.name: Packet the Proto P
protos.description:
Packet is a cyber and information warfare support specialist, sometimes even deployed out in the field when the situation calls for it. She's able to provide support as a forward Information/Electronic Warfare sensor and attack platform, network node, data analysis and heuristics engine, and Electronic Countermeasures / CounterCountermeasures suite when deployed alongside infantry or CATS - typically in low-signal/no-signal or interference heavy areas, as well as missions requiring on-site/hands-on information warfare capability. Despite being a quasi-field unit, she's actually terrified of live combat. When not assigned to fieldwork, she can often be found performing her Cyber / Information warfare duties remotely, hooked up to external power and ICT infrastructure physically and 'in' the EM spectrum and various networks mentally

Thanks to the HAB-IO port she is able to fully integrate into compatible systems, removing data transmission bottlenecks and allowing for extreme data throughput, albeit at the cost of extreme power drain - necessitating the use of a PROTO External Connector. Increased workloads when using the HAB-IO connector may require the use of a PEC Special High-Power Supply System (PEC-HPS) to prevent supplemental power being drawn from onboard batteries. She is most effective when paired with another CAT or support vehicle that is able to provide power via PEC and passthrough the more powerful CATS grade networking equipment. She also has a General Purpose Input/Output header in her standard chin-mounted IO, allowing her to run adhesive circuit traces across her body and adapt to any required physical datalink on the fly, however this is only capable of a comparatively lower bandwidth typically seen in standards such as USB, HDMI, Firewire, etc.

She absolutely loves her work - to a degree some may consider unhealthy - often needing to be ordered to stop working past the end of her duty shifts. She can tend to struggle a little when in non-technical conversations, often times unintentionally coming off as cold or disinterested.  Despite outward appearances and conversational difficulties, she has a quite a soft spot for the CATS and PROTOS she works alongside, especially for a particular PW-Mk.1 aerocat. 

She's also very vocal about how she's happy how she is with how things are, and how she REALLY doesn't want to be transferred into a CATS frame (for some reason). There have also been some rumours she used to be a human, though she denies them vehemently 

'Get me one good scarp, and I'll get us their nets'

protos.creator: Bnoy
protos.name: Bnoy the Proto 2.0
protos.description: he is the personal mechanic for the aero cat barrier (MiG 25) he can be bratty and bossy but only while working other than that hes rather kind to everyone

protos.creator: Porto Morio
protos.name: Tenpo the Proto 2.0
protos.description: Tenpo used to belong to a wealthy writer, but after certain circumstances, he came to belong to a musician. Now he is a bass guitarist. Tenpo has remained kind, affectionate, and peaceful. Although he is shy around the public, with good friends he is open and cheerful. He wears T-shirt of a band where he is participating

protos.creator: Seba200725
protos.name: Perez the Proto I
protos.description: [REDACTED]

protos.creator: VeasleyKess
protos.name: Hazel the Proto 2.0
protos.description:
Originally named 'C4rrot V' he was the Lead of the CottonTails Research and Development Division before stepping down and joining the CottonTails Test Team as an assistant for director Kesstrel, He later adopted the name 'Hazel' given to him by the team as way to prevent confusion with the C4rrot co-pilots as well being part of the Test Team's family.

He gave the C4rrot Co-pilot's their own nicknames, C4rrot I is now Called Calibre, C4rrot II as Woundwort and lastly C4rrot IV as Owsla

He's also very accident prone, the more notable example was when he almost got his whole head burned due to him ignoring the testing parameters, luckily his internals was fine only his display and ear plugs got heavily damaged which later got replaced by new parts which took the team two weeks to outsource.

protos.creator: notwebber
protos.name: Dr.Ruby the Proto 2.0
protos.description:
Chemist, assigned to research the properties and origins  of PDG and the effects it has on organisms and CATS.

Notes: Has difficultly interacting with CATS and Protos outside of their small social circle...

protos.creator: SwetD
protos.name: Pinky the Proto 2.0
protos.description:
Actually this proto was designed as a weapon. Pretty appearance should make the victim step closer, before the core explodes. Deals more impact being closer to the target, as it should. While on base or safe object the core stays unarmed.

Notes: Don't poke the belly, it has a small chance to make the core armed.

protos.creator: Mangoshibi
protos.name: D04-TY the Proto 2.0
protos.description:
'aka dirty'

General Janitor. Got a hanger that needs a clean up? Co-Pilot that hasn't taken out all the take-out?? She's the girl to call!!

protos.creator: Freccia
protos.name: HA-08 the Proto P
protos.description:
Nile is the quintessential worker: Precise, punctual and obsessively organized, yet possessing a surprisingly 'fluid' and warm bedside manner.

He is inherently supportive, if a coworker is tired, Nile will take the lead on the heavy wading without being asked, viewing it as logical efficiency.

Company File Note: Unit HA-08 shows an unsual habit of 'greeting' rivers before samping. While not required by LDG protocol, it appears to improve his emotional processing stability.
